instructions_to_main_agent: JavaScript (.js / .jsx) codebase - DO NOT use TypeScript syntax or types
Ensure Framer Motion is heavily utilized for scroll reveals, staggered child cards, and smooth hover scales
Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) for all technical, service, and contact icons
Use Sonner for contact form submission and interactive feedback toasts
Header MUST be fixed/sticky with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050B16]/80 border-b border-cyan-500/10 z-50)
Every button MUST have a dark navy to electric blue gradient hover with glowing border effect
CRITICAL: Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements (buttons, nav links, inputs, service filters, project cards, branch cards, tabs, form controls)
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without generic flat gradients. Use deep dark navy #050B16 with selective cyan glows
Do NOT make generic centered layouts. Use offset Swiss grid, glass cards, bento grids, and diagonal tech lines
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (glowing ambient backdrops z-0, cards z-10, floating badges z-20)
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (backdrop-blur-md to backdrop-blur-xl)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add specific transitions (e.g. transition: border-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease)
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center }). Preserve natural left reading flow for content
NEVER use emoji characters 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 as UI icons. Use clean Lucide-react vectors
Use generous padding: p-6 to p-12 inside containers to avoid border collision
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='nav-link-services', data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='contact-submit-button')
